messages:
harper: Opening a small PR to clarify how we report bench numbers on model cards and to fix a couple of stale perf links. Draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1533 :wave:

lucas: Thanks. Can you make the guidance explicit about measurement units (tokens/s vs sequences/s) and whether numbers are cold or steady-state?

harper: Yes. Plan: a short "Bench reporting guidance" snippet in the model-card template that requires: seq_len, batch, device, quant, p50/p95, tokens_per_sec, and whether KV cache was primed.

miri: Please include an example bench command and sample output so writers have a concrete copy/paste example. Suggest the perf-harness command we actually run.

harper: Example I'll include:
```
# perf-harness example
python perf_harness.py --model glacier4b --seq_len 1024 --batch 1 --iters 500 --device a100 --quant fp16 --collect p50,p95,tokens_per_s
```

zhou: Call out normalization caveats. We used a heuristic conversion in the docs draft: norm_throughput = raw_tps * (baseline_flops / measured_flops). Mark it as "heuristic" and link to perf-harness README for the actual hardware counters.

harper: Will add that and a short sentence: "Normalization is approximate; use only for rough comparisons."

lucas: Also a short note about cross-region variance (5-12%) when using hosted endpoints, and recommend local lab runs for canonical numbers.

miri: For quant variants include delta rows (int8 vs fp16) and a seq_limit column. Some variant names reduce context length in practice.

harper: Adding a 2-row illustrative table in the template (not exhaustive) and linking to the full model-catalog table for authoritative values.

lucas: Link fixes: current model-catalog page points to /perf/benchmarks which is stale. Replace with https://github.com/redwood-inference/perf-harness#readme in any docs that point there.

harper: I'll update all instances I find and add a PR note listing changed files.

zhou: Reviewer plan: eng-ml to sanity-check numbers and conversion math, eng-runtime for variant naming, docs for wording. Add changelog entry if we update canonical numbers.

docs-bot: Reminder: Add labels docs, perf-needed (if numbers changed), and changenote when merging. I will post the PR checklist on open. (automated)

miri: Small editorial ask  keep examples short and avoid adding full model tables inline. Link to the catalog for the full matrix.

harper: Agreed. I'll keep the card template example minimal and leave GH issues for perf re-runs if needed. Drafting now, pinging reviewers in the PR description. ETA EOD. last_message_ts=3501234890
